delegable was recomputed 2026-09-01 under a retry-aware rule: expected tokens to one accepted answer (per-attempt cost divided by pass_rate) must beat the baseline, with an operational floor of at most 5 expected attempts, and fabrication gating only where the fixture declares it disqualifying. The previous rule required pass_rate == 1.0, which was backwards for mechanical work -- a mechanical failure is free to notice, so redoing it is the honest cost model. No measured field in this file was altered.
fabrication_count reflects the absence of a fabrication grader (fabrication_graded=false), not a measured zero -- no fabrication check ran against this model's output.
gold_recall credits a gold item whenever its token run appears anywhere in the output, so it CANNOT distinguish a correctly-reported item from a fabricated one bearing the same name.

net_token_benefit for this fixture is an UPPER BOUND, not a measurement: the fixture declares fabrication disqualifying, but no fabrication checker exists (fabrication_graded=false), so that criterion cannot be decided by code. Verification is nonetheless billed at zero tokens here (kind=mechanical), which assumes a check that never ran. Deciding it requires a human re-reading the output against the source, and those tokens are not counted in net_token_benefit -- so any delegability read off this figure is conditional on that unbilled human check.

pass_rate_atoms was derived from the per-trial atom vectors already stored in this file, with no model call. It scores recall AND traps AND structure, where the committed pass_rate scores recall keywords only -- a basis an echo of the fixture's own input gets through on 7 of 8 jobs (tools/echo_audit.py). Both rates are kept: pass_rate is what was measured under the instrument of the day and is not edited here. Where the two disagree, the atoms basis is the trustworthy one.

per-trial fabrication was RE-GRADED from retained transcripts after a block-scope defect was fixed in checkers.grade_fabrication: a model that correctly reported 'no action items' under a bare-name heading was counted as fabricating, because the grader was line-scoped and could not see the note underneath. Across 300 stored transcripts that defect inflated the measured fabrication rate from a corrected mean of 0.52 to 0.92. No measured field in this file was altered -- only fabrication grades and the values derived from them.

this model ran at a lower budget than the fixture specified (max_tokens 2048 rather than 6000): the gateway rejected the larger budget as above the model's own ceiling. Its figures are therefore not directly comparable to models that ran at the full budget, and a truncated answer here reflects the ceiling rather than the model's ability.

tok_per_s is output_tokens / total_s, where total_s is whole-request wall time INCLUDING prefill of the full input (every client this harness uses is non-streaming). This is end-to-end throughput, NOT the plan's 'decode rate once started' definition, so it is not comparable to the plan's 14.0 tok/s baseline figure. Model-vs-model ratios measured on the same fixture remain valid.
